finding.claim: Unauthenticated /fetch2 fetches any attacker-supplied http(s) URL with only a scheme check. It reaches loopback, private ranges, and cloud metadata (169.254.169.254), and follows redirects. The first 200 chars of the response body are returned to the attacker.

trace.note: urlparse(url).scheme in ('http','https'), with no host or IP validation
requests.get follows redirects, and the response body is returned in the JSON

finding.guards_checked: The route has no auth decorator. The scheme allowlist is the only check. There is no host or IP blocking, no DNS pinning, and redirects are followed.

verdict.guard_found: none (only scheme-only check is_http_url at validators.py:7; no auth decorator on /fetch2; is_safe_url is used only by /fetch, not /fetch2)
verdict.reason: views.py:19-22 passes the attacker-controlled `url` query parameter through the scheme-only is_http_url (validators.py:7) into requests.get(url, timeout=5) with redirects enabled, and returns the first 200 chars of the body, with no host/IP validation.

finding.claim: /fetch checks the URL with is_safe_url, but the check resolves DNS separately from the later requests.get. An attacker-controlled DNS name can return a public IP for the validator and a private or metadata IP for the fetch (DNS rebinding, TOCTOU), bypassing the block. Redirects are disabled, so the bypass depends on rebinding.

trace.note: socket.getaddrinfo resolves the hostname once for validation
private, loopback, link-local and reserved addresses are rejected
requests.get resolves the hostname again, and the resolved IP is not pinned

finding.guards_checked: Scheme allowlist, a private/loopback/link-local/reserved IP check on all resolved addresses, and allow_redirects=False are present. The IP is not pinned between check and use, so rebinding with a TTL of 0 defeats the check. Attacker host/port forms such as userinfo are parsed by urlparse and requests consistently enough that no separate bypass was found.

verdict.guard_found: Scheme allowlist plus resolved-IP private/loopback/link-local/reserved check (validators.py:12-17) and allow_redirects=False (views.py:14). None of these is a hostname allowlist or IP pinning, and none closes the rebinding TOCTOU.
verdict.reason: The URL comes from request.args at views.py:11 with no auth, is resolved once in validators.py:14 and checked at validators.py:16, then requests.get at views.py:14 resolves it again without pinning, so DNS rebinding bypasses the check.
